notes: Addressed an issue where player pets were unable to damage The Winter Squall.
Addressed an issue where interacting with Food Offering while mounted can cause it to no longer be interactable for a short period.
Reduced the number of Earthwhisper Tenders in the first area by 2.
Thornclaw Gatherer: Rotten Supplies cooldown increased to 17 seconds (was 14 seconds).
Fixed an issue where the Radiant Drake entrance-return NPC did not appear in Mythic+ after defeating the final boss.
Adjusted enemy forces requirement to keep routing the same as before.
Deepstone Earthshaper’s health reduced by 8%, and Techtonic Strikes damage vulnerability reduced to 25% (was 35%).
Flashfrost Chillweaver’s health reduced by 10%.
Primalist Cinderweaver’s Living Bomb periodic damage and explosion damage reduced by 10%.
Thunderhead and Flamegullet: Fixed an issue where certain abilities could cause their breath spells to cancel unexpectedly.
Kyrakka and Erkhart Stormvein: Addressed an issue where Ekhart could target an unexpected player with Stormslam.
Thunderhead: Fixed an issue where Electrical Discharge would sometimes fail to hit players.
Addressed an issue where Xathuux the Annihilator's Axe Toss can sometimes inflict less damage than intended.
Addressed an issue where Malefic Wave can sometimes fail to hit players.
Addressed an issue where Row Snitch can be uninteractable.
Lithiel Cinderfury: Fingers of Gul’dan now prefers non-tank players.
Lithiel Cinderfury: Fingers of Gul’Dan number of targets reduced to 4 (was 5).
Lithiel Cinderfury: Fingers of Gul’dan number of Wild Imps summoned increased to 4 (was 3).
Updated visuals of Taz'Rah's Darkbloom orbs to better match their impact radius.
Adjusted spawning of a pack near the Harrower to be closer to the stairs.
Taz'Rah: Nether Dash line visuals now turn more smoothly.
Atroxus: Addressed issues with the voice lines not matching the spells.
Addressed an issue where Brutok's Smashing Charge can charge through doors.
Removed one High Evolutionist in the area after Rav'i.
Ravenous Descendant’s Ravenous now grants 10% attack speed per stack (was 20%), and movement speed reduced by 20%.
Twinfang Harrower’s Paralyzing Shots initial damage reduced by 50%.
Venom Leech’s Septic Spatter no longer creates a puddle at the leech’s corpse location.
Ritual Chieftain’s Blood Sacrifice absorb reduced by 10%.
Caustic Mist Totem’s Unstable Totem damage reduced by 10%.
High Evolutionist’s Evolve cooldown increased, Envenom cast time increased to 3 seconds (was 2.5 seconds), and Mass Envenom cast time increased to 3.5 seconds (was 2.5 seconds).
Bloodletter’s Bloodletting now procs less frequently.
Ascendant Serpent health reduced by 10%.
Rav’i: Feeding Frenzy no longer increases the rate of Messy Eater and Carrion Burst.
Rav’i: Fresh Meat piles now display a warning visual when Rav’i is close enough to eat from them.
Rav’i: Hydrastrike damage reduced by 33%.
Zul’jan: The initial cast of Ritual of the Fang now occurs a few seconds later in the encounter.
Zul’jan: Ritual of the Fang cast time increased to 5 seconds (was 4 seconds).
Zul’jan: Fang Empowered damage reduced by 20%.
Increased enemy forces requirement to 686 (was 655).
Adjusted spawning in the last area to reduce creature density.
Removed a Radiant Spellsower before Ziekket.
Potatoad Matriarch: Increased enemy forces value to 60 (was 30).
Potatoad Matriarch: Reduced health by 10%.
Potatoad Matriarch: Toxic Spew initial damage reduced by 50%.
Potatoad Matriarch: Toadspawn target radius reduced to 3-7 yards (was 10 yards), and eggs now finish hatching even if the Matriarch is dead.
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: Addressed an issue where Bloodthorn Root is affected by disorient effects.
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: Resolved an issue preventing Death Knights from casting Consumption after the Death Knight has been picked up by Bloodthirsty Gaze.
Finished Mummy and Half-Finished Mummy are now marked as elites.
Risen Hexer now casts Shadow Bolt (was Shadowfrost Bolt).
Phantom Hex Priest now uses Shadow magic (was Nature).
Increased Shadow of Zul’s ability cooldown.
Bloodsworn Assassin’s Sudden Rupture now prefers not targeting the same player consecutively.
The Council of Tribes: Kula the Butcher’s Whirling Axes visual updated.
The Council of Tribes: Aka'ali the Conqueror and Zanazal the Wise now wait briefly before attacking players.
Adjusted enemy forces requirement to keep routing the same as before.
Swarming Krolusks now idle for longer after spawning before attacking.
Avatar of Sethraliss: Fixed an issue where the progress bar could reach 100% when the Avatar reached 99% health.
Fixed an issue where Spark Channeler could be turned unexpectedly.
The enemy forces requirement has been adjusted to take this fix into account. This change does not affect routing.
